about.eyebrow: WELCOME TO YOUR HOME AWAY FROM HOME
about.title: Good moments are
about.story: Bananov Rai is a place for shared moments. Near Tsonevo Reservoir, our guest house brings together the warmth of a Bulgarian home, a refreshing swimming pool, a green garden and the unexpected charm of our banana trees.
about.detail: Gather your family, invite your friends and make time for one another. Three floors of accommodation, a spacious traditional mehana and places to unwind outdoors await at our family-owned house.
about.caption: Our green corner near Tsonevo
